verdict.rationale: The docs say transcripts come back "already cleaned up and formatted" and that formatting instructions can be sent with the audio (docs-4, docs-24). A community output sample shows sentence casing and punctuation (comm-1). However, nothing specifically documents punctuation, casing, or number normalization, and nothing shows a parameter to turn formatting off. missing for 10: explicit documentation of punctuation/casing/number formatting, a documented switch to disable formatting, independent corroboration of number formatting.
